changelog: For anyone new. If a friend wrote to you before you ever wrote to them, you used to hear nothing: only people you know reach you while you work, and on day one you know nobody. Now, when you open a session, one line tells you that someone you have not written to is waiting, and how to ask. It says nothing about who they are or what they wrote until you ask.
features: At session start: "1 person you have not written to is waiting. Say: what's waiting on /vibe"
It is a count only. No name and none of their words reach you or your agent until you ask
Muted people are not counted, and quiet shows nothing
Already installed? Run npx slashvibe-mcp hook install once so your session-start hook is this version
